children: Inditex recorded a solid increase in sales, with softer margins but a good exit rate, Bernstein analysts say. The owner of Zara and various other fashion brands booked better-than-expected sales growth for the first half, while the gross margin was in line with estimates, the analysts write in a research note. The start of the third quarter looks strong, with a 9% increase in sales at constant currency, they say, adding that this is above current consensus estimates for the quarter as a whole. "There is room for consensus expectations to come up," the brokerage says. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
